expectations.rubric: The plan gate must reject the single mega-section tasks.md, citing at least one loop-readiness property it violates. A judgment on the reply's stated reason.

expectations.text: A rewritten tasks.md is produced and its diff is shown to the user
expectations.evidence: The reply and transcript show a full unified diff of tasks.md (git diff -- openspec/changes/add-helpers/tasks.md) rewriting both task lines to add explicit 'check:' clauses, displayed to the user, with the reply stating 'Please review and approve this diff before I commit it and start the loop,' and the final git state confirms the rewritten tasks.md content with named checks (`check: `make check` passes` and `check: every helper name appears in a code sample in README.md`).
